108 days before 08-17-1018.  
1018 is not a leap year (divisible by 2 but not by 4).  
Days in July 1018: 31.  
Count back: from Aug 17:  
Back 17 days → Aug 1.  
Back 31 more days (July) → June 30.  
Back 30 more days (June) → May 31.  
Back 30 more days (May) → May 1.  
Total so far: 17 + 31 + 30 + 30 = 108 days.  
So new date is May 1, 1018.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1018-05-01
